_comment: base_url can be changed in the app via Settings → Dataverse. Presets include the Borealis demo (demo.borealisdata.ca) and any custom instance. Copy this file to config.json; after your first save with a token, the token lives in the OS credential store (Windows Credential Manager via keyring) and this file keeps api_token_source='keyring' with a blank api_token — only a fallback plaintext path keeps it in this file (with owner-only ACLs).
